translationRepairs: Chinese 〈（特末）〉 is a parenthetical annotation for 特末; the English retains stray ]〉 after the name, so cleaning to (Temuo) fixes real garbling without changing meaning.
Same unit 〈（特末）〉; literal likewise has garbled trailing ]〉, and (Temuo) restores a clean parenthetical matching the annotation.
At the time Regent Han Kuangsi had followed the court north; Jing and his son Derang jointly administered capital affairs.
At the time Regent Han Kuangsi had followed the court north; Jing and Han's son Derang jointly administered capital affairs.
In 景與其子德讓共理京事, 其 refers to the preceding 留守韓匡嗣, so Derang is Han's son; the literal's 'Jing and his son Derang' wrongly makes Derang Liu Jing's son, and 'Han's son Derang' corrects that.
